title: Southern Syncopators and drummer Nolan Williams
summary: Allen asks about the Southern Syncopators; Reason says Shine, Nolan Williams, was their drummer.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: And who were the Southern Syncopators? Do you remember that band? Well, the Southern Syncopators, they were from New Orleans. I think that was Sidney Desvigny. I see. I get all these things mixed up. Yeah, Sidney Desvigny.
Now, this drummer that I told you a while back that we got to play with us in Homer, his name was, we used to call him Shine.
But Shine's right name was Nolan Williams.
And he was the drummer with the Southern Syncopators.
